how_read: scripts/kb/fetch_wiki_live_pages.py --api https://fallout.fandom.com/api.php --titles <pages> (page text as rendered by the wiki, link markup removed). Every quoted sentence below was checked, by script, to appear word for word in the page text read at the revision named. Every page used is the Fallout: New Vegas page of its subject (or, for Bighorner, Fiends and the other pages that cover only this game, the wiki's own page); no other Fallout game's page or section is used. In-game text the wiki quotes (loading-screen lines, terminal entries, item descriptions) is not used.

lines.line: Summary: Big armored scorpions of the Mojave that run straight at you in packs of two to five, striking with claws and a poisoned tail. They are rough on a low-level Courier, and Damage Threshold means an unprepared Courier struggles to put them down.

quoted: As radscorpions almost always move in groups of two to five, they can be very dangerous to low-level players.
the addition of Damage Threshold makes them harder to kill for an unprepared Courier.
They tend to charge their intended targets directly and will use their powerful claws and poisoned tails for quick and relentless attacks.

lines.line: Weak points: The claws are the softest part, and crippling them stuns the scorpion. Armor-piercing weapons work well against it, with the Guns skill. Do not hope for a head shot bonus: it has no head or other spot that takes extra damage, which blunts V.A.T.S. and ordinary firearms.

quoted: Their claws are less-armored than the rest of the carapace; successfully crippling these will stun the radscorpion.
the creatures are vulnerable to armor-piercing weaponry.
radscorpions lack a "weak point" that can be targeted for extra damage (they have no "head," for example), which makes V.A.T.S. combat and firearms somewhat less effective against them.

lines.line: Looks like: Apart from size, an ordinary scorpion with a mottled, dark blue-gray shell. The common kind runs from a large dog to small livestock in size, and the rare queen is bigger than a Corvega.

quoted: Apart from their size, they appear visually identical to normal scorpions, with mottled, dark blueish-gray carapaces.
Their size ranges from that of a large dog to that of small livestock.
she is larger than a Corvega.

lines.line: Tips: The giant radscorpion is rarer and faster, hits much harder and has a Damage Threshold like a sentry bot's, and some stand just outside Goodsprings and its cemetery, so you can meet one very early. Only two queens are known: one is south of the Nipton Road pit stop, in the scorpion burrow, and the other is in the Searchlight fire station, reached during a side quest. Ruby Nash will cook you a casserole if you bring her a radscorpion gland.

quoted: A larger and much more dangerous variant of radscorpion that is faster, as well as rarer than the usual radscorpion.
has a higher Damage Threshold (on par with that of a sentry bot)
The player can encounter them very, very early on, since some of them are just outside Goodsprings and Goodsprings Cemetery.
It does a lot more damage
Only two are known to exist in the Mojave Wasteland
One can be found in the scorpion burrow south of the Nipton Road pit stop
Another queen can be found inside the Searchlight fire station
accessed during the side quest Wheel of Fortune
After killing a radscorpion, one can take its gland to Ruby Nash and she will make Ruby's casserole

lines.line: Summary: Reptile packs found across the whole Mojave. When one gecko fights, the whole pack joins in, charging or leaping in with open jaws and clawing quickly. Some kinds breathe fire or spit poison from a distance.

quoted: Geckos can be found living across the entire Mojave Wasteland
Geckos are generally found in small packs.
Once a single gecko attacks something or is attacked, its pack will join the fight.
They charge or leap at their opponents with their mouths open, ready to snap down.
some subspecies of geckos can breathe fire or spit a poisonous liquid as a ranged attack.

lines.line: Looks like: A lizard with two fins sprouting behind the head, orange-tinted eyes and five fingers and toes, anywhere from a small child's size to taller than a grown adult. Golden geckos have bright gold scales; fire geckos are mottled purple and red with spikes down the back.

quoted: Geckos are reptilian and born with a pair of fins behind their heads.
Their eyes possess an orange tint
Geckos have evolved with five fingers and five toes.
they range from the size of a small human child, to heights exceeding that of an average human adult.
This type of gecko is distinguishable by brilliant golden scales.
Fire geckos have mottled purple and red hides and prominent spikes on their backs.

lines.line: Tips: Plain geckos, the mildest kind, roam around Goodsprings and near the Mojave Outpost, and along Interstate 15 toward Primm. Golden geckos live in irradiated places such as Crescent Canyon, Vault 34 and Cottonwood crater, and their attacks do heavy radiation damage. Fire geckos favor mountains and caves such as Lucky Jim Mine and Nopah Cave. The Animal Friend perk works on geckos and golden geckos but not on fire geckos, which run if hit by a flare gun. Tanned gecko hides can be made into armor.

quoted: Geckos can be found in the areas surrounding Goodsprings, along the Interstate 15 towards Primm, and around the Mojave Outpost.
These are the least dangerous species of gecko found within the Mojave.
They can be found around irradiated areas such as Crescent Canyon east and Crescent Canyon west, Vault 34, Cottonwood crater
exposure to radiation has caused their attacks to inflict significant amounts of radiation damage.
They can mainly be found in and around mountainous areas and caves, such as the Lucky Jim Mine and Nopah Cave.
Geckos, green geckos, and golden geckos are classified as animals and are affected by the Animal Friend perk. Fire geckos, however, remain hostile to the Courier despite the perk.
fire geckos will flee if shot with a flare gun
the hides, once tanned, can be used to craft several varied types of armor

lines.line: Summary: Mutated praying mantises that came out of Vault 22 and spread across the Mojave. Each is much smaller than a person, so they swarm whenever they can and mostly leap in to slice with their forelegs.

quoted: Giant mantises are mutated praying mantises created by the horticultural experiments that took place in Vault 22.
They have since escaped from the vault and have spread into the Mojave Wasteland.
They are still much smaller than humans, but make up for that by attacking in swarms whenever possible.
giant mantises' attacks mainly consist of jumping and slicing its target in mid-air with their forelegs.

lines.line: Weak points: Crippling a mantis's antennae sends it into a frenzy, so it lashes out at anything within reach.

quoted: If a mantis' antennae becomes crippled, it will become frenzied and the mantis will begin to attack anything within reach.

lines.line: Looks like: Much like a real praying mantis, only far bigger, though still smaller than a person. The young nymphs are much smaller than the adults, and some die just from being walked over. The Zion Canyon kinds are larger.

quoted: their biological traits have remained relatively unchanged when compared with the original specimen, except for significantly increased size.
They are still much smaller than humans
They are much smaller and weaker than adult mantises.
Some nymphs can be killed simply by walking over them.
They are much larger and more dangerous than the other varieties of giant mantis that are found in the Mojave Wasteland.

lines.line: Tips: Weak nymphs turn up early in the Goodsprings schoolhouse and Nevada Highway Patrol station; the adults wait later, around Spring Mt. Ranch State Park and on the road toward Jacobstown. Shooting an ootheca releases about a dozen nymphs, which then attack. Dead mantises can yield eggs and forelegs.

quoted: They are usually found early in the game at the Goodsprings schoolhouse and the Nevada Highway Patrol station
There are quite a few mantises on the way to Jacobstown and around Spring Mt. Ranch State Park.
encountered later in the game around Spring Mt. Ranch State Park or on the way to Jacobstown
Shooting a mantis ootheca will release a dozen giant mantis nymphs, which will then attack.
Mantis eggs and mantis forelegs may be taken from their dead bodies.

lines.line: Summary: Tough armored mutants that favor heavy guns, plus melee weapons like the super sledge. Gunners walk slowly toward you while firing; melee fighters throw frag grenades and then rush in. Plain mutants give way to brutes and masters as you level.

quoted: Super mutants often use heavy guns and melee weapons such as heavy incinerators and super sledges.
relying on their superior health and armor for protection from attacks
The melee variants rush the player after throwing their frag grenades and the ranged mutants will shoot at the player from a distance while they slowly advance
Standard super mutants appear at lower levels and will be replaced with brutes and masters at higher levels.

lines.line: Looks like: Brutes can be told apart by helmets and rough metal armor. Nightkin have deep purplish-blue skin and wear no armor.

quoted: They can be distinguished by their helmets and crude metal armor.
Their skin tone is deep purplish-blue in color.
Nightkin do not have any armor

lines.line: Tips: Ordinary super mutants are armored to Damage Threshold 15, the same as combat armor; nightkin wear none but shrug off 30 percent of damage. Nightkin use Stealth Boys to creep up on their prey. Black Mountain is the main stronghold. Hostile ones reliably come back at Black Rock Cave, Jack Rabbit Springs and a small cave north of Ranger Station Bravo. Hostile ones often carry miniguns, light machine guns or super sledges that you can sell.

quoted: All regular super mutants wear armor which gives them a Damage Threshold of 15, equal to a suit of combat armor.
Nightkin do not have any armor but benefit from an innate 30% Damage Resistance.
these volatile beings utilize Stealth Boys to sneak up on their prey.
The main super mutant stronghold in the Mojave Wasteland is Black Mountain
the only places with consistently respawning enemy super mutants are Black Rock Cave, Jack Rabbit Springs, and the small cave north of Ranger Station Bravo.
Hostile mutants will often carry higher-end weapons such as miniguns, light machine guns, super sledges, and more, which can then be sold elsewhere.

lines.line: Summary: Mutants that are somewhat humanoid in shape. They fire a slow, high-arcing radioactive spit and whip at close range with their tongues. One alone is no great danger, but they rarely come alone.

quoted: all known centaurs are somewhat humanoid in appearance
a high-arcing, slow-moving saliva projectile
it utilizes its tongue to whip at any intruders
Individual centaurs only pose a minor threat, but as a rule of thumb, centaurs rarely travel alone and are usually found with other centaur variants or super mutants.
They are not as powerful but give the victim dramatically high doses of radiation.
In close combat, centaurs do low to moderate damage depending on the variant

lines.line: Weak points: They are slow and clumsy, and the spit travels so slowly that it is easy to sidestep.

quoted: the low speed of these projectiles makes them fairly easy to evade.
They can easily be avoided though, as they are very unagile.

lines.line: Looks like: The common kind keeps only a human-like head and torso, with three long tentacle-like tongues where back spines would be. Evolved centaurs are bigger and more muscular, with thick clusters of tumors on their backs.

quoted: only the human-like head and torso remain, and the spines on the back are replaced by three long, tentacle-like tongues.
they have significantly more muscle mass, as well as thick clusters of tumors growing from their backs.

lines.line: Tips: The tongue lash does little physical damage but a notable amount of radiation. Groups gather at Jack Rabbit Springs, south of Black Mountain, and in the Devil's Throat east of Bitter Springs, where evolved ones and the single giant evolved centaur stay. They respawn there three days after being killed.

quoted: Though it does not cause much physical damage, it inflicts a notable amount of radiation damage.
Some can be found south of Black Mountain, at Jack Rabbit Springs and a large group of them reside in The Devil's Throat, east of Bitter Springs.
Only one giant evolved centaur can be found in the game, located in the Devil's Throat.
It normally re-spawns three days after being killed, along with the other centaurs found there.

lines.line: Summary: Mutated sheep, grazing wild in herds of three to seven or kept by settlements like Goodsprings and Jacobstown. They leave you alone until you or their young get close, then they bellow, charge and ram, and the entire herd joins in if one of them is upset.

quoted: Bighorners are mutated bighorn sheep native to the American Southwest.
Several settlements, such as Goodsprings and Jacobstown, have domesticated them
primarily found in wild herds of three to seven
They will not attack unless something comes in proximity to them or their young.
they will rear their heads up and bellow, afterwards charging and attempting to ram their foe.
if one member of the herd is distressed, the entire herd becomes aggressive.

lines.line: Weak points: They are about as hardy as a radscorpion. A hit on the horns counts as a head shot, and a critical hit blows the head apart.

quoted: they are squarely on par with a radscorpion in terms of health
Hitting a bighorner's horns counts as a headshot.
A Critical Hit will blow up a bighorner's head.

lines.line: Looks like: A horned sheep; every bighorner grows horns, whatever its sex. Bulls are larger and stronger, and the young are about a third of full size.

quoted: All bighorners grow horns, regardless of sex.
Bighorner bulls are stronger, larger versions of bighorners
Young bighorners are roughly a third of the size of their fully grown counterparts

lines.line: Tips: The compass shows them hostile, but unprovoked ones do not chase you; leave them be and they graze. Their head-butts are brutal, flinging you back or knocking you down, and they run very fast; bulls in a group keep knocking you over. Hurting one of the young turns its relatives on you, and penned calves in towns are watched by ranchers who turn hostile if you harm them. With the Animal Friend perk they never turn on you.

quoted: if left alone, are content to graze and mind their own business
Though marked as hostile on the compass, unprovoked bighorners will not actively pursue the player like other creatures
their head-butting attacks are devastating, capable of sending enemies flying backwards or knocking them down.
Bighorners can also run very fast.
their charges will continue to knock the Courier over until they are beyond their range.
attacking one of these will cause their nearby family members to turn hostile and attack.
these are often guarded by ranchers that become hostile if any harm comes to their livestock.
With the Animal Friend perk, bighorners will not turn hostile toward the player, no matter their proximity.

lines.line: Summary: Large insects with big mandibles that can be a real nuisance early in the game. Workers wear you down with nonstop swarming attacks, and soldiers are the biggest of the usual kinds.

quoted: These creatures can be a bit of a problem in the early stages of the game.
What they lack in individual fortitude, they make up for with relentless attacks and swarm tactics.
The largest and strongest variant of the more common giant ant variants.

lines.line: Weak points: A hit on the antennae counts as a critical hit and also sends the ant into a frenzy. A worker's shell is not especially hard next to a radscorpion's.

quoted: Hitting their antennae will count towards a critical hit and will also frenzy them.
a worker ant's exoskeleton is not particularly hard compared to radscorpions.

lines.line: Looks like: A big ant in a yellow-brown shell with large mandibles and long antennae. The queen is the biggest creature anywhere in the Mojave.

quoted: Giant ants are large insects protected by a yellow-brown carapace.
They have large mandibles
Their long antennae sprout out of the head
The giant ant queen (or fire ant queen) is the largest creature in the Mojave Wasteland.

lines.line: Tips: They are not fast, so if you fight them from a distance you can simply walk away from them. Workers roam in groups across barren desert, including the Ivanpah race track and Ivanpah Dry Lake; several soldiers are inside the Allied Technologies offices. One queen exists, in the mound south of those offices. At the Nellis array the ants blow up if hit by energy weapons or explosives.

quoted: they are not particularly swift, and can easily be out-walked if the player character prefers to engage them at range.
Giant worker ants can usually be found in barren stretches of desert in the Mojave, such as the Ivanpah race track and the Ivanpah Dry Lake.
Several can be found inside the Allied Technologies offices building.
Only one giant ant queen appears in Fallout: New Vegas, located in the ant mound south of the Allied Technologies offices
The ants at the Nellis array will explode when shot with energy weapons or explosives

lines.line: Summary: Ghouls that lost their minds to heavy radiation exposure and attack everyone except their own kind. Shrill and fast, they are dangerous mainly in numbers or to a low-level Courier.

quoted: Due to exposure to high levels of radiation, they have lost the ability to reason
they have lost the ability to reason and will become hostile towards everyone but their own kind.
Despite their shrill noise and speed, they are only truly a threat when they have the advantage of numbers, or when the Courier is at a low level.

lines.line: Weak points: A plain feral ghoul falls to one or two head shots from a decent ranged weapon, or one solid melee or unarmed hit.

quoted: they are easily dispatched with one or two headshots from any decent ranged weapon or a solid hit from a decent melee or unarmed weapon.
weaker than standard human opponents

lines.line: Looks like: Like normal ghouls but with deformed faces, skinnier, and moving oddly. The plain kind wears only tattered shorts; reavers wear what look like scraps of metal armor.

quoted: Feral ghouls are similar in appearance to sapient ghouls, but with deformed facial features.
They are also skinnier and do not walk or run normally.
wearing only a pair of tattered shorts
They wear what appears to be the remnants of metal armor.

lines.line: Tips: Roamers are more dangerous than the plain kind and far more common. At low levels a reaver is only slightly stronger than a roamer, and in the Mojave it no longer gives off radiation. Glowing ones turn up at higher levels where radiation is worst, with much more health and damage and a burst of radiation. Expect ferals in the Vegas sewers and around Hell's Motel, the Devil's Throat and the Nevada Highway Patrol station. The armor they wear is for show.

quoted: The feral ghoul roamer is more dangerous than the regular feral ghoul.
Though it is not as strong as the feral ghoul reaver, it is far more common.
at lower levels, they are merely slightly stronger than a feral ghoul roamer
their lunges do not cause as much knockback and they no longer emit radiation.
These ghouls are found often at higher levels, and at locations where the concentration of radiation is strongest.
They have significantly more health and damage than the average feral ghoul.
Its secondary attack is when it stretches its arms to the sky then gives off a burst of radiation.
They are usually found in the Vegas sewers or in areas with high radiation, such as around the Devil's Throat, Hell's Motel and Nevada Highway Patrol station.
Any armor worn by ghouls appears to be purely cosmetic

lines.line: Summary: Heavy military robots on wheeled tripod legs, armed with a Gatling laser or minigun on one side and a missile launcher on the other. They have a lot of health, so they are hard to put down, especially at a low level.

quoted: Sentry bots found in the Mojave have two arms that end with deadly weapons (a minigun or Gatling laser on the right arm, and a missile launcher on the left arm), and tripod legs with wheels.
Because of their high health and destructive weapons, sentry bots are formidable combatants and can be difficult to put down, especially fighting them at a low level.

lines.line: Weak points: They are open to electromagnetic pulses, so pulse grenades, pulse mines and any other EMP-producing weapon can hurt them badly. Destroying the combat inhibitor mounted on its back sends it berserk, and it then attacks everything around it.

quoted: Being a robot, sentry bots have no defense against electromagnetic pulses (EMP), so they can be heavily damaged by pulse grenades, pulse mines, or any other weapon that produces an EMP.
sentry bots have a combat inhibitor on the back of their chassis that, when destroyed, will cause the sentry bot to go berserk and attack everything near it.

lines.line: Looks like: Armored head, wheeled tripod base. The REPCONN ones are shorter, with green eyes instead of red and REPCONN in white across the chest.

quoted: They also have armored heads
tripod legs with wheels
They are also much shorter in height and have glowing green eyes instead of red.
emblazoned in white across their chest

lines.line: Tips: At long range a sentry bot leans on its missiles; once you are close it switches to the minigun or Gatling laser to avoid splash on itself. Head shots do less damage to it. Hardened sentry bots, met with hardened Mister Gutsies near the crashed vertibird, have about 500 hit points against 300 but no armor at all, and resist pulse grenades better. Twelve REPCONN bots hide in the headquarters and come out if you trip the alarm.

quoted: once the target reaches mid to close range, sentry bots rely primarily on their minigun/Gatling laser attachments instead of their missile launchers to avoid splash damage.
receive less damage from head shots.
Hardened sentry bots have nearly twice as much health as a standard sentry bot (500 hit points as opposed to 300 hit points).
they are completely unarmored with a DT of 0
One result of their increased raw health is a greater resistance to pulse grenades.
They are encountered along with hardened Mister Gutsies around the crashed vertibird in the Mojave Wasteland.
with twelve of them hidden within the building.
If the player trips the alarm system, these bots will emerge from the hidden rooms inside the building.

lines.line: Summary: A gang of raiders who are all chem users driven mad, working the outer New Vegas area and holding the southwestern ruins of Vegas. They fight in small war parties.

quoted: The Fiends are a raider gang made up entirely of deranged chem fiends, hence their name, in the outer New Vegas area in 2281.
They control the southwestern ruins of Vegas
the Fiends split into small war parties, usually between three and four members

lines.line: Looks like: Red eyes, always, from constant chem use. They wear assorted raider armor and helmets decorated with painted ruminant skulls.

quoted: Fiends always have red eyes, a side effect from their constant chem consumption.
They dress in various raider armors and wear distinct helmets adorned with war-painted ruminant skulls.

lines.line: Tips: Their melee gear includes knives and pool cues, and for guns they mostly carry silenced .22 SMGs, varmint rifles and caravan shotguns, plus an unusual number of Laser RCWs and plasma rifles. Nearly a dozen spots spawn Fiends between 0600 and 2230, and none spawn from 2230 to 0600, so night is the calmer time to cross the Vegas countryside. Everyone but the Great Khans is a target. With a Speech of 65 you can pass as a Great Khan chem seller to the guard of Vault 3, which makes the Fiends inside peaceful; those outside stay hostile.

quoted: from basic melee weapons such as knives and pool cues, to an unusually large number of high-tech range weapons like Laser RCWs and plasma rifles
They are mostly found carrying basic guns like caravan shotguns, varmint rifles, and silenced .22 SMGs.
Random Encounters: There are nearly a dozen spots spawning Fiends in the time range from 0600-2230.
In the deep of the night, from 2230 to 0600 the next morning, they do not spawn, so this serves as a comparatively safe time to move around Vegas' countryside.
The Fiends attack anyone aside from the Great Khans
With a Speech check of 65, one can convince the main guard of Vault 3 that they are a Great Khan selling chems
This will make all Fiends inside Vault 3 non-hostile with the player character.
However, the Fiends outside of Vault 3 will remain hostile in normal gameplay

lines.line: Summary: The basic healing injection of the Mojave: a hand-held shot that mends minor wounds on the spot.

quoted: A stimpak is a hand-held medication used in healing the body.
it provides immediate healing of the body's minor wounds.

lines.line: Uses: Base healing is 30 hit points and limb condition, and it grows with your Medicine skill, from 36 hit points at skill 10 to 90 at skill 100. In Hardcore mode it heals over time instead and cannot mend a crippled limb; for that you need a doctor or an item that says it heals limbs, such as Hydra or a doctor's bag.

quoted: +30 HP and Limb Condition
+36 Hit Points
+90 Hit Points
stimpaks will heal over time (versus instantly) and will not heal crippled limbs.
Limbs can only be healed by a doctor or with the use of items that specifically indicate limb healing in their information, including, but not limited to, Hydra, a doctor's bag

lines.line: Tips: You can craft one at a workbench from a broc flower, an empty syringe and a xander root with Science 70. Most doctors sell them, and Cliff Briscoe in Novac nearly always has some. With a good reputation among the Followers of the Apocalypse, Julie Farkas at the Old Mormon Fort hands out one free each day. Doc Mitchell's house holds three.

quoted: Broc flower (1)
Empty syringe (1)
Xander root (1)
Science: 70
In addition, most doctors sell them.
Cliff Briscoe in Novac almost always has stimpaks (as well as other aid items and skill books) in his inventory for sale.
They can be obtained free from Julie Farkas at the Old Mormon Fort once per day with a good reputation with the Followers of the Apocalypse.
Three in Doc Mitchell's house.

lines.line: Summary: A consumable made for healing crippled limbs, and it does that job in normal play and in Hardcore mode alike.

quoted: A doctor's bag is a consumable item in Fallout: New Vegas.
The bag may be used to heal all limbs for a small amount
serving this purpose in both normal and hardcore modes.

lines.line: Uses: Used plainly, it gives every limb a small boost; applied from the stats screen to one limb, it fixes far more. In Hardcore mode a doctor, Hydra, sleeping in a bed you own, or the Honest Hearts items healing poultice, daturana and weapon binding ritual will also mend crippled limbs.

quoted: The bag may be used to heal all limbs for a small amount, or through the stats screen, can be applied to a single limb for a much greater effect.

in hardcore mode, the only other ways to heal crippled limbs are to be healed by a doctor, using Hydra, sleeping in an owned bed or using the aid items healing poultice, daturana or weapon binding ritual from the Honest Hearts add-on.

lines.line: Tips: You can craft one at a workbench with Medicine 40 from forceps, a medical brace, a scalpel and surgical tubing. Early ones sit in the Goodsprings gas station and in Doc Mitchell's house, and Doc Mitchell gives two more during Ghost Town Gunfight if your Medicine is 30. Viper gunslingers rarely carry one.

quoted: The item can be crafted at a workbench.
Forceps (1)
Medical brace (1)
Scalpel (1)
Surgical tubing (1)
Medicine: 40
One can be found in the Goodsprings gas station in the middle of the left aisle.
There is one in Doc Mitchell's house in Goodsprings.
Two can be acquired from Doc Mitchell in the quest Ghost Town Gunfight with a Medicine skill check of 30.
Rarely found on Viper gunslingers.

lines.line: Summary: Two radiation chems that work at opposite ends: Rad-X raises your resistance before you go into a hot zone, and RadAway clears radiation after exposure. Neither is addictive.

quoted: While Rad-X is designed to increase the body's natural resistance to radiation, RadAway is designed to be used after exposure.
Like stimpaks and RadAway, Rad-X is non-addictive

lines.line: Uses: RadAway always removes 50 rads plus your Medicine skill, from 60 at skill 10 to 150 at skill 100; in Hardcore mode it works over ten seconds. Rad-X gives resistance for four minutes, from 30 percent at skill 10 to 75 percent at skill 100. More doses lengthen the time but do not stack the strength, and resistance tops out at 85 percent, so no gear makes you immune.

quoted: Because RadAway's base effect is exactly 50, it will always remove 50 + skill rads
-60 Radiation
-150 Radiation
-6 Radiation for 10s
+30 % Radiation Resistance for 4m
+75 % Radiation Resistance for 4m
Taking multiple doses of Rad-X does not increase the total radiation resistance (the effects do not stack).
Instead, the drug's active time is lengthened
Radiation Resistance caps off at 85%
No combination of Rad-X and radiation-resistant clothing will grant total immunity to radiation

lines.line: Tips: Doctors are the usual source: Doc Mitchell in Goodsprings, Dr. Ada Straus in Novac and Senior Scribe Linda Schuler in the Hidden Valley bunker. Most shops carry only one to three RadAway, if any. Vault 34's clinic safe holds both chems, and Charleston Cave has three Rad-X. Twenty doses of RadAway earns the Free Radical perk.

quoted: Doc Mitchell in Goodsprings, Dr. Ada Straus in Novac or Senior Scribe Linda Schuler in the Hidden Valley bunker.
most shops only have one to three in stock, if any at all, though it is often stocked by doctors.
Vault 34 has a small stockpile of RadAway and Rad-X inside an Average locked safe in the clinic.
After taking 20 doses of Rad-Away, the Free Radical perk will be gained, enhancing the effectiveness of RadAway.
Three in Charleston Cave.
Fifteen in Vault 34.

lines.line: Summary: A camouflage gadget, worn on the wrist or as a belt pouch, that makes you almost invisible for a short while. In the Mojave, nightkin are the ones you usually see carrying them.

quoted: The result makes the wearer almost invisible to the untrained eye.
wrist-mounted disc and an emitter in a canvas carrying pouch worn on the belt
In the Mojave Wasteland, they are typically found in the hands of the nightkin

lines.line: Uses: One gives +100 Sneak and +75 Stealth Field for two real minutes, which is one in-game hour. A second one used while the first runs adds another in-game hour to what is left. The Chemist perk, the Day Tripper perk and the Logan's Loophole trait stretch the time. The Sneak boost also helps stealth-based Speech checks, and pulse grenades do not affect the device.

quoted: +100 Sneak for 2 minutes
+75 Stealth Field for 2 minutes
The effect lasts for one in-game hour, or 2 real-time minutes.
adding one in-game hour to the duration remaining from the previous Stealth Boy
The Chemist, Day Tripper perks and Logan's Loophole trait also affect the Stealth Boy duration.
Stealth Boys temporarily increase the Sneak skill to 100, which affects stealth-related Speech checks.
pulse grenades do not have any effect on the Stealth Boys.

lines.line: Tips: Early ones: a locked safe in the Goodsprings schoolhouse (Lockpick 25), and one beside a skeleton at Jack Rabbit Springs. The REPCONN test site holds six in fixed spots, and nightkin bodies there may give more. Vikki and Vance Casino hands one over for winning 1,250 or more chips.

quoted: Goodsprings schoolhouse - One can be found in a locked safe (Lockpick 25).
